swap: disabled on signing host; encrypted if enabled on build host
hardware_virtualization: Not required for compilation. Optional separate emulator runner needs KVM; physical tests use the development Pixel after explicit approval.
additional_dependency: Node.js 24 LTS and Yarn; record verified installer and exact versions in runner image manifest
network: Existing authenticated egress proxy and supplied CA trust; no policy bypass
signing: Separate offline host, tmpfs working area, no public CI jobs or network
retention: Preserve signed target-files, full OTA, factory image, sources, checksums, SBOM and evidence for every shipped build outside ephemeral workspace
